implementations.title: Archetypes and Theme
implementations.summary: Give the spec a shape axis and a look axis, so a chess app and a gear tracker stop being the same CRUD app with a different adjective.

implementations.title: Drawing Freedom
implementations.summary: Raise the visual ceiling of a generated app by ranking display options on whether the verifier can tell they worked — not on what Docker permits.

implementations.title: The Improvement Loop
implementations.summary: Let a prototype be told to keep getting better, with a ratchet that reverts any iteration leaving it less green than it found it.

implementations.title: Plan Prototypes and Dreaming
implementations.summary: Add `proto plan`, which turns an idea into a researched, connected, organised set of text plans, plus a dreaming step that collects, evaluates and proposes lighter extensions of the idea.

implementations.title: The proto Console
implementations.summary: A terminal front end for the tool itself — type the idea in one pane, watch generation in another — built as a second view over the job seam `proto serve` already paid for.

implementations.title: Remove Prototyping
implementations.summary: Delete everything that generates, runs or verifies an app, both front ends included, so that the surviving CLI is plan, dream, ls, rm, prune and doctor.

implementations.title: The Terminal Target
implementations.summary: Make the output medium an axis and build a terminal target beside the web one — gated on a measurement, because the model has seen far less Textual than FastAPI.
